queries.query: LLM-generated network configurations OR network change plans failure modes OR hallucinations OR incorrect commands OR unsafe actions
queries.rationale: Directly capture empirical reports and analyses of the phenomenon: when LLMs produce incorrect, unsafe, or operationally harmful NetOps outputs.
source_preferences: technical blogs only as pointers (then verify primary source)

queries.query: agentic LLMs OR autonomous agents for NetOps OR tool-using network agents OR multi-tool orchestration for network management failure analysis
queries.rationale: Survey mechanisms and system-level behaviours introduced by agentic orchestration (tool use, action sequencing, stateful loops) that can produce new failure modes.

queries.query: generate-validate-repair pipeline OR generate-then-verify OR verifier-assisted LLM configuration synthesis AND Batfish OR Header Space Analysis OR NetKAT OR VeriNet
queries.rationale: Search for concrete mitigation architectures combining LLM generation with deterministic/network-specific validators and repair loops.

queries.query: formal verification of network configurations OR static analysis network config reachability safety 'Header Space Analysis' 'reachability'
queries.rationale: Locate mature deterministic validators and formal methods that can be paired with LLM outputs for operational validation.

queries.query: constrained decoding OR controlled generation OR safety filters OR RLHF for operational constraints in LLM outputs
queries.rationale: Find LLM-side mitigation mechanisms (decoding constraints, safety classifiers, reward-model alignment) applicable to NetOps outputs.

queries.query: tool-assisted self-correction OR LLM verifier loop OR chain-of-thought verification applied to config synthesis OR RAG (retrieval augmented generation) for NetOps
queries.rationale: Investigate methods where LLMs use tools/retrieval/verification iteratively to improve correctness in domain-specific tasks like NetOps.

queries.query: benchmarks for LLMs in networking OR AIOps benchmarks OR NetOps evaluation suites '6G-Bench' 'TSNBench' 'OpsEval' 'NetBench' 'configuration synthesis dataset'
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmarks/datasets and evaluate their suitability and gaps for operational reliability and safety evaluation.

queries.query: evaluation methodology for NetOps reliability metrics OR correctness metrics for generated configs OR repair success rate false positives false negatives operational impact
queries.rationale: Find recommended metrics, statistical approaches, and pitfalls when assessing operational correctness and safety of automated NetOps outputs.
source_preferences: measurement and evaluation papers (CNSM, IMC, SIGCOMM)

queries.query: network emulation and experiment environments for NetOps evaluation Mininet ns-3 GNS3 container-based labs OR cloud testbeds for config execution AND safety considerations
queries.rationale: Locate practical execution environments and their fidelity limits to support experimental evaluation of LLM-generated changes.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop NetOps studies OR operator acceptance OR decision-support vs autonomous change experiments OR usability of LLM suggestions in operational teams
queries.rationale: Understand human factors, mitigation strategies via operators, and comparative studies between automation and human oversight.
source_preferences: HCI/CSCW venues, USENIX, practical operator studies, industry case studies, arXiv

queries.query: adversarial and robustness testing of LLM-generated code/configs OR prompt injection for NetOps OR distribution shift effects on generated network actions
queries.rationale: Search for work on adversarial threats and robustness evaluations relevant to operational deployment of LLM-generated NetOps artifacts.
source_preferences: security conferences (USENIX Security, CCS), arXiv, NeurIPS robustness workshops, GitHub adversarial toolkits

queries.query: reproducibility, provenance, and experiment logging for LLM-driven NetOps research OR best practices prompts seeds model-version logging
queries.rationale: Find methodological guidance and tooling patterns to ensure experiments are auditable and reproducible (critical for the track constraints).
source_preferences: arXiv, reproducibility workshops, FAIR data guides, GitHub projects (MLFlow-like)

queries.query: ethical, legal, compliance frameworks for autonomous agents in infrastructure management OR operational risk assessment for AIOps
queries.rationale: Identify regulatory, safety, and governance literature relevant to deploying autonomous NetOps agents and required mitigations.
source_preferences: policy papers, IEEE/ACM tech-policy venues, arXiv, white papers from standards bodies (IETF/ETSI)

queries.query: neighboring fields: program synthesis, automated program repair, code generation evaluation metrics OR lessons transferable to network-configuration repair
queries.rationale: Harvest methods and evaluation designs from program synthesis/repair communities applicable to NetOps configuration synthesis and repair.

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, arXiv preprints with verifiable authorship) or project repositories with clear provenance
Direct relevance to Generative AI/LLMs applied to NetOps OR to validators, formal verification, emulation environments, or operator studies tied to network configuration/change
Empirical results, datasets, tool descriptions,benchmarks, or detailed methodologies (not just high-level opinion pieces)
Publicly accessible artifacts (code, datasets, benchmarks) or papers with verifiable identifiers (DOI/arXiv ID)
Publications from ~2018–2026 as primary window, with inclusion of older seminal network-verification works where directly cited and relevant
Works that provide metrics, scripts, or reproducibility details useful for experimental design or validation
Papers describing failures, mitigation architectures (generate-validate-repair), or evaluation pitfalls in operational contexts
exclusion_criteria: Purely general LLM/NLP research without NetOps or operational-automation relevance
Marketing materials, speculative blog posts or vendor claims without traceable primary technical artifacts (except as leads to primary sources)
Proprietary/closed datasets or private corporate artifacts that cannot be inspected or cited publicly
Benchmarks that only test factual/network knowledge Q&A (e.g., trivia-style networking questions) without configuration or operational semantics
Pre-lock development artifacts that are not publicly archived (per programme constraints)
Works that cannot be verified (no DOI/arXiv/DOI-equivalent or accessible project page)
date_rationale: Primary search window: 2018–2026 to capture the transformer/LLM era and the recent surge in agentic systems (2022–2026). Allow earlier seminal works (e.g., Batfish, Header Space Analysis, NetKAT-era papers from 2000s–2015) when they are foundational to validators/formal methods; these older items must be explicitly flagged as 'seminal foundational' during review.
